text:
sara_marketing: Hey team — we need a short, scannable 1-pager for enterprise prospects that compares private vs dedicated vs hosted inference focused on security, SLA and latency tradeoffs. Deadline: EOD Wed. Include: TL;DR, one benchmark narrative, an inbound lead routing playbook snippet, and a 10-15s webinar blurb.

devon_product: Sounds good. I'll draft the copy. Suggest structure: 1) One-line value prop + hero stat, 2) Quick matrix (security / latency / cost), 3) Routing & SLAs, 4) CTA & webinar.

aj_sales: Target persona = platform + security leads. Add a short sales blurb for discovery calls (why pin model/version, when to ask for Dedicated/Private).

kai_design: I can do the visual layout if copy lands by Tue noon. Prefer a 1-column mobile-friendly layout and an A/B variant for field vs technical audiences.

sara_marketing: @devon_product add a tiny benchmark narrative comparing tail latency on small-q4 prompt (50 tokens) across modes — we can use numbers like: Hosted: 80ms P50 / 250ms P95; Dedicated: 60ms P50 / 120ms P95; Private (on-prem): depends on infra — show a range. Keep phrasing conservative.

devon_product: Draft hero stat: "Ship secure, predictable LLM inference — 2x lower tail-latency with Dedicated vs burst-hosted for production traffic." Will add conservative numbers and note measurement context. Linking to benchmark doc: https://intra.redwood/benchmarks/inference-latency (internal).

aj_sales: For routing: include a short playbook bullet list so SDRs know when to route to AE / Solutions (e.g., >1M tokens/mo + compliance ask -> AE; regional isolation + HSM -> Solutions). Keep it 3 bullets.

kai_design: For visuals: I'll provide 2 icons (Security lock, SLA shield), a compact latency sparkline, and a callout box for "When to choose Dedicated". Need copy for the callout (<20 words).

sara_marketing: Draft callout: "Choose Dedicated when predictable P95 latency and data isolation are non-negotiable — ideal for scale & compliance." Thoughts?

devon_product: Nice. Here's a very short benchmark narrative we can drop into the one-pager:
```
Benchmark narrative: In a 50-token conversational workload sampled from production prefixes, Dedicated instances achieved median latency 60ms and P95 120ms, compared to Hosted median 80ms and P95 250ms. Prefix caching and batching explained; private on-prem results vary with GPU class (A100 vs H100). Metrics measured under steady 200 rps sustained load.
```

aj_sales: Sales one-liner for the top: "Reduce inference surprises — predictable latency, clear SLAs, and private deployment options for regulated workloads." Use this on outbound emails.

kai_design: Working on A/B headline options, will upload mock in #design-assets by Wed morning.

sara_marketing: Also add a 15s webinar blurb: "Join our webinar: Serving LLMs in regulated environments — real benchmarks, routing playbooks, and migration patterns. 30 min + live Q&A." Keep CTA: Register link (we'll plug later).

launch-bot: Reminder set: Draft due by Tue 12:00 to #design-assets and Wed EOD publish to website. :bell:

devon_product: I'll ping with the first draft in ~3 hours. Will include a tiny FAQs section: "What counts as 'predictable'?" and "How do we measure P95?"

sara_marketing: Perfect. @aj_sales prepare a quick customer quote we can anonymize for the callout box if you have one. Otherwise I'll pull from the case study repo. :sparkles:

aj_sales: Got one we can anonymize — short line about latency stability. Will post here shortly.

kai_design: Emoji check: :thumbsup: on visuals plan.

sara_marketing: Great work team — let's keep it tight and field-ready.
